newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Mecon cut to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mecon cut to neutral.

text.p: -- Cowen & Co lowered its recommendation on Mecon Inc to neutral from strong buy.
-- The shares plummeted 8-1/8 to 6-7/8 in early afternoon trading on the Nasdaq.

-- Late Monday, the company said it planned to take a third-quarter restructuring charge of about $1.5 million. It also warned that earnings before the charge in the quarter ending December 31 would be little changed or lower than profit in the corresponding period a year earlier.

-- The charge is related to the integration of managed-care information systems unit, centralization of management of its product development, sales and product support organizations, and increased investment in the development of new products.
-- MECON will also relocate its headquarters to larger facilities to accommodate the changes.
-- The company also said Les Schmidt would serve as chief executive officer in addition to his post as president. Vasu Devan, previously chairman and chief executive officer, will remain chairman.
